Great idea. Do you want to meet me there?
Yes, of course! I'll be there at two o'clock. It's not far from my house.
Perfect. See you then!
See you! Oh, and don't forget your water bottle.

messages.content: Hi, Li Fang! It's a sunny Sunday afternoon here in Haidian. I'm feeling very happy to be outside.
Oh, that's great! I'm also feeling good. The air is so fresh today. I'm walking my dog, Wangwang.
Yes, walking dogs is nice. By the way, I love flying kites in Beijing. It reminds me of New York parks I saw on TV.
Oh, interesting! Well, flying kites in Gonghe Park is also very fun here. We often fly them in the morning.
That sounds nice. I plan to play badminton later. Do you know the Tianjin badminton club?
Well, I know the club in Tianjin. It's quite famous. But I prefer playing in our local community center near here.
I see. My club is better than any other place I've visited.
Oh, really? That's very good. I think your coach must be very skillful. Can you play well?
Yes, I can. I've played for many years. What about you?
Well, I'm not very good at badminton. But I'm good at reading books in the library after sports.
That's a good idea. Reading is relaxing. I'll go to the library with you next time.
Of course! Let's meet at the library gate at three o'clock. It will be a nice day.

messages.content: Hi Wang. I'm renovating my old apartment in Zibo. It's quite tiring work.
Oh, really? That sounds hard work. I'm helping my uncle fix his kitchen in Linyi.

Okay, I will go there. I hope it's not too expensive.

That's great. I hope my work goes well too.

Thank you for your help. I am going to pay now.
You are welcome! Please enjoy your new coat in the snow.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Hua. I help at the community fair in Chengdu today.
Oh, that's great work! I'm Li, the manager here. We're having a big festival.
Yes! We are selling dumplings and hot pot. It smells amazing.
Wow, the food sounds delicious. I love spicy food too. By the way, do you need more volunteers?
Not yet. My friend Sarah wants to come. She loves the music.
Oh, nice! We have traditional drums and guzheng music. Sarah will like it.
Maybe. But John from the US wants to join. He knows guitar.
Interesting! We have many guitarists here too. They play folk songs.
Really? What kind of songs? I want to learn some.
Well, we play songs about nature and family. It's very moving.
That sounds nice. Can I bring my guitar tomorrow?
Of course! We are happy to have you. See you at the square then?
Yes! I will be there at ten. Thanks for asking me.
